description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kamburugamuwa North, Weligma D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, locations, and ownership details. The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
